# ship-agents

Your interface to the `agents` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`agents.catalogs`](references/docs/agents.catalogs.mdoc) — Catalog rows for the agents list (harnesses, skills, etc.).
- [`agents.create_ctx`](references/docs/agents.create_ctx.mdoc) — Convenience: templates + presets + harnesses for the create view.
- [`agents.detail`](references/docs/agents.detail.mdoc) — Full view-shaped agent detail — catalogs, permissions, harnesses, tags.
- [`agents.get`](references/docs/agents.get.mdoc) — Raw agent doc from disk at the requested scope.
- [`agents.harnesses`](references/docs/agents.harnesses.mdoc) — Enumerate known harnesses (claude, openai, gemini, ...).
- [`agents.list`](references/docs/agents.list.mdoc) — List all agents as minimal IndexEntry rows.
- [`agents.permission_presets`](references/docs/agents.permission_presets.mdoc) — Permission presets for the agent-create wizard.
- [`agents.settings`](references/docs/agents.settings.mdoc) — Tier list + catalog rows for the per-agent settings pane.
- [`agents.summaries`](references/docs/agents.summaries.mdoc) — List all agents with display metadata (label, harnesses, tags).
- [`agents.templates`](references/docs/agents.templates.mdoc) — Starter templates for the agent-create wizard.
- [`agents.wire`](references/docs/agents.wire.mdoc) — Graph payload (nodes + edges) for the agent-wire canvas.

## Commands

- [`agents.create`](references/docs/agents.create.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Create a new agent profile from a doc.
- [`agents.delete`](references/docs/agents.delete.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Delete an agent profile (scope omitted walks project → user).
- [`agents.duplicate`](references/docs/agents.duplicate.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Copy an agent profile to a new id.
- [`agents.move_scope`](references/docs/agents.move_scope.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Move an agent profile between project and user scope.
- [`agents.patch`](references/docs/agents.patch.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Apply RFC-6902 ops to an agent profile's doc.
- [`agents.put`](references/docs/agents.put.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Replace an agent profile's doc (use agents.create for net-new).
- [`agents.rename`](references/docs/agents.rename.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Rename an agent profile's id.
